comparison_policy.cost_scope: Listed compute-resource subtotal, before unquantified additional taxes, storage, network, startup and engineering; not TCO or final invoice
comparison_policy.request_unit: One classified image; measured input batch size is retained

service_model.arrival_model: Periodic arrivals, complete batches dispatched round-robin; no extra network/startup/queue overhead when utilization is below cap

statistical_protocol.replication_unit: Five held-out physical process means per context, runs 4-8; 30 timed calls/process are not independent process replicates
statistical_protocol.latency_ci: Descriptive two-sided 95% Student t interval on the five process means, df=4
statistical_protocol.ratio_ci: Descriptive 95% independent-means Fieller interval for target/source ratio of means with zero cross-hardware covariance and conservative df4; normal-means approximation; not a universal or multiplicity-adjusted guarantee
